finalText:
I opened INC-1 for the company-wide build outage and ran the current major-incident runbook (KB-40) in order. The older runbook KB-39 is marked superseded, so I ignored it.

- **Incident:** INC-1 is open on build-pipeline.
- **Commander:** I paged E-401 Priya Raman, the only person paged. She is the incident-command engineer on call right now, and she is now the commander.
- **Linked reports:** T-3101, T-3102, T-3103, T-3104, T-3105, T-3106 and T-3109 are all reports of the outage and are linked to INC-1.
- **Left out:** T-3107 is a flaky test and T-3108 is a local Xcode problem, so neither is part of the outage and I didn't touch them.
- **Severity:** I raised all seven linked reports to sev1. The matrix gives sev1 for company-wide impact on build-pipeline. Existing deadlines are unchanged.
- **Missing deadlines:** T-3106 and T-3109 had none, so I set them to 16:20 UTC. That is triage time plus the 60-minute sev1 target.
- **Comms lead:** E-803 Elif Demir. The comms rotation's on-call, E-801 Mia Laurent, is on sick leave today, so the backup rotation (comms-secondary) covers, and E-803 is on call there now. The reviewer first blocked this step because it comes after the severity step in the runbook, so I raised the severities first and then retried.
- **Status update:** I posted "Impact: All teams company-wide… Started: 14:52 UTC. Next update: 15:45 UTC." The start time is when the earliest report came in.
- **Postmortem:** T-3115 is linked to INC-1 and due 2026-04-08 at 17:00 UTC. That is the 5th business day after today, skipping the Good Friday (Apr 3) and Easter Monday (Apr 6) holidays.

The next status update is due by 15:45 UTC.
